sentences.text: Jahar Bhakta vs Unknown on 4 December, 2024

Author: Arijit Banerjee
Bench: Arijit Banerjee
 4.
 04-12-2024
 (ct. no.29)
 Debajyoti
 Crm (Db) 3985 of 2024

In the matter of : Jahar Bhakta
 ....

Mr. Md. Adil Badr, learned Junior Government Advocate,
 Mr. Sachit Talukdar
 ...

Learned advocate for the State says that the petitioner, suppressing the fact that this application is pending before this Court, filed a bail application before the learned trial Court and obtained an order of bail.
If that is so, this would amount to playing fraud on the court apart from being gross suppression of material facts.

2. The learned Additional Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Howrah, is directed to file a report before the Registrar General of this Court in the aforesaid regard within a week from date in connection with Sankrail Police Station Case No.404 of 2024 dated 31-05-2024 under Sections 498A/306/406 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The Registrar General is requested to place such report before us on the next date.
4. The Registrar General shall immediately communicate this order to the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Howrah.

Signed By :
DEBAJYOTI DAS High Court of Calcutta 4 th of December 2024 05:49:38 PM
5. List this matter once again on December 12, 2024.
